\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{സ്വത്ത്} (svattŭ)}{സ്വത്ത് (svattŭ)}]{\ml{സ്വത്ത്} (svattŭ) — property; possessions}

\label{lesson:ML-C394-svattu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a stone inscription, then the Malayalam for to commemorate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സ്വത്ത്}}
\textbf{\ml{സ്വത്ത്}} — \emph{svattŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}property; possessions\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{മുത്തച്ഛന്റെ} \ml{സ്വത്ത്} \ml{മക്കൾക്ക്} \ml{കിട്ടി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{muttacchanṟe svattŭ makkaḷkkŭ kiṭṭi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The children got grandfather's property.
\end{quote}

Land, a house, money: everything one owns. \ml{സമ്പത്ത്} is wealth in general.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{സ്വത്ത്}} (\emph{svattŭ}) is usually traced to Sanskrit \emph{svatva}, \textquotedblleft{}proprietary right, property\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), from \emph{sva}, \textquotedblleft{}own\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{svattŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{svattŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{muttacchanṟe svattŭ makkaḷkkŭ kiṭṭi.} — The children got grandfather's property.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a stone inscription, then the Malayalam for to commemorate, then say \emph{svattŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{സ്വത്ത്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Property; possessions\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അവകാശി} (avakāśi)}{അവകാശി (avakāśi)}]{\ml{അവകാശി} (avakāśi) — an heir}

\label{lesson:ML-C394-avakasi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to commemorate, then the Malayalam for property.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{അവകാശി}}
\textbf{\ml{അവകാശി}} — \emph{avakāśi} — \textquotedblleft{}an heir\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{അവൻ} \ml{ആ} \ml{വീടിന്റെ} \ml{ഒരേയൊരു} \ml{അവകാശി} \ml{ആണ്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{avan ā vīṭinṟe orēyoru avakāśi āṇŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He is the only heir to that house.
\end{quote}

From \ml{അവകാശം}, a right: one who has the right to inherit.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{അവകാശി}} (\emph{avakāśi}) is built on \ml{അവകാശം} (\emph{avakāśaṁ}), \textquotedblleft{}a right\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{avakāśa}, \textquotedblleft{}space, room; opportunity\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 728), with the person ending -\ml{ി}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avakāśi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avakāśi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avan ā vīṭinṟe orēyoru avakāśi āṇŭ.} — He is the only heir to that house.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to commemorate, then the Malayalam for property, then say \emph{avakāśi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{അവകാശി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An heir\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്} (osyattŭ)}{ഒസ്യത്ത് (osyattŭ)}]{\ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്} (osyattŭ) — a will; a testament}

\label{lesson:ML-C394-osyattu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for property, then the Malayalam for an heir.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്}}
\textbf{\ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്}} — \emph{osyattŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a will; a testament\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{മരിക്കുന്നതിന്} \ml{മുൻപ്} \ml{അദ്ദേഹം} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്} \ml{എഴുതി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{marikkunnatinŭ munpŭ addēhaṁ oru osyattŭ eḻuti.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Before he died he wrote a will.
\end{quote}

A will is written or made: \ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്} \ml{എഴുതുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്}} (\emph{osyattŭ}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{waṣiyya}, \textquotedblleft{}a bequest\textquotedblright{}. It belongs to the language of courts and land deeds.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{osyattŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{osyattŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{marikkunnatinŭ munpŭ addēhaṁ oru osyattŭ eḻuti.} — Before he died he wrote a will.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for property, then the Malayalam for an heir, then say \emph{osyattŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഒസ്യത്ത്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A will; a testament\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{വിധവ} (vidhava)}{വിധവ (vidhava)}]{\ml{വിധവ} (vidhava) — a widow}

\label{lesson:ML-C394-vidhava}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for an heir, then the Malayalam for a will.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{വിധവ}}
\textbf{\ml{വിധവ}} — \emph{vidhava} — \textquotedblleft{}a widow\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{യുദ്ധത്തിന്} \ml{ശേഷം} \ml{ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ} \ml{ഒരുപാട്} \ml{വിധവകൾ} \ml{ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yuddhattinŭ śēṣaṁ grāmattil orupāṭŭ vidhavakaḷ uṇṭāyirunnu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
After the war there were many widows in the village.
\end{quote}

Plural: \ml{വിധവകൾ}, \emph{vidhavakaḷ}.

Plural \ml{വിധവകൾ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{വിധവ}} (\emph{vidhava}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{vidhavā}, \textquotedblleft{}a widow\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 11752).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vidhava}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vidhava}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{yuddhattinŭ śēṣaṁ grāmattil orupāṭŭ vidhavakaḷ uṇṭāyirunnu.} — After the war there were many widows in the village.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for an heir, then the Malayalam for a will, then say \emph{vidhava} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{വിധവ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A widow\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പൈതൃകം} (paitṛkaṁ)}{പൈതൃകം (paitṛkaṁ)}]{\ml{പൈതൃകം} (paitṛkaṁ) — heritage; an inheritance}

\label{lesson:ML-C394-paitrkam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a will, then the Malayalam for a widow.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പൈതൃകം}}
\textbf{\ml{പൈതൃകം}} — \emph{paitṛkaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}heritage; an inheritance\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{പഴയ} \ml{വീട്} \ml{ഞങ്ങളുടെ} \ml{കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ} \ml{പൈതൃകം} \ml{ആണ്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā paḻaya vīṭŭ ñaṅṅaḷuṭe kuṭumbattinṟe paitṛkaṁ āṇŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
That old house is our family's heritage.
\end{quote}

What the fathers left: a house, a craft, a custom.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പൈതൃകം}} (\emph{paitṛkaṁ}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{paitṛka}, \textquotedblleft{}belonging to a father, paternal, ancestral\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), from \emph{pitṛ}, \textquotedblleft{}a father\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paitṛkaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paitṛkaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā paḻaya vīṭŭ ñaṅṅaḷuṭe kuṭumbattinṟe paitṛkaṁ āṇŭ.} — That old house is our family's heritage.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a will, then the Malayalam for a widow, then say \emph{paitṛkaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പൈതൃകം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Heritage; an inheritance\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
